description: A stylish mid-century modern armchair and ottoman set. The armchair features a high backrest with button tufting and a supportive headrest, complemented by wide armrests. It sits on a swivel base with a central column and three splayed legs, providing stability and a dynamic look. The accompanying ottoman is perfectly proportioned to offer a comfortable footrest. Both pieces are upholstered in a warm, tan-colored leather that exhibits a slight sheen, suggesting quality and comfort. The set is placed on a few planks of rustic wooden flooring, which contrasts with the smooth upholstery and the dark, minimalist background. This design evokes a sense of sophisticated relaxation and timeless elegance.
